description: This PHP source file acts as an AJAX handler for WiFi spectrum analysis diagnostics. It includes functions to process MAC addresses, rearrange SDTR values, retrieve neighboring WiFi diagnostic results, and control WiFi diagnostics state, returning data as JSON.

methods.name: mac_translate
methods.description: Converts MAC address to uppercase and formats it with colons if not already formatted.

methods.name: rearrange_SDTR
methods.description: Adds a newline character after every third element in a comma-separated string.

methods.name: get_results
methods.description: Retrieves neighboring WiFi diagnostic results, formats BSSIDs, and returns status and data.
